verdict.rationale: Bento's own docs say releases are scored on live traffic as well as offline and in CI. Its plain-English signals are trained on your traces, fire in real time on production data and backfill history, which is continuous evaluation on live traffic rather than only on datasets. missing for 10: detailed docs on how live evaluators are configured (scoring types, sampling rates, latency), independent or hands-on corroboration that real-time scoring works as claimed.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: Every release scored against your production history — offline, in CI, and on live traffic.
Bento trains a detector on your own traces, fires it in real time, and backfills your history.
Bento trains a signal on your own traces, fires it in real time, and backfills your entire history
